Goal achieve karne se zyada zaruri hai ki tum kya ban gaye.
"Hum upar uthte hain jab dusron ko uthate."
Waves rok nahi sakte, surf seekh sakte.
Distraction time ka chor hai.
Failure ho ya success—persistent rehna zaroori.
Taiyar raho.
"Soch bovo, action kaat lo."
Effort ka substitute nahi.
Sahi track par bhi baithe rahoge toh kuch nahi hoga.
"Tum destined wohi bante ho—jo decide karte."
Sahi raste par baithe rehna bhi nuksaan hai.
Hustle excuses ko hara deta hai.
